standard-dialogue.npc: What are you doing in our home?

standard-dialogue.player: I just came to ask you a question.

standard-dialogue.npc: Hegir, why did you let this human into our home?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Hegir
standard-dialogue.text: I didn't let him in, he let himself in!

standard-dialogue.npc: Now what do you want, human? Speak up, speak up!

standard-dialogue.player: I ehm, just wanted some information.

standard-dialogue.npc: Well go ask someone else instead of barging into people's homes!

standard-dialogue.speaker: Hegir
standard-dialogue.text: There's no need to be rude to the human, Haera dear.

standard-dialogue.npc: Now don't you dear me. I'll do whatever I please.

standard-dialogue.player: I think this is my cue to leave...

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-on-her-s.npc: Get your hands off our property, human!

steps.npc: Don't talk to me like that!
